description:
Deletes a share permission from a filter.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** Permission to access Jira and the user must own the filter.

parameters.description: The ID of the share permission.
parameters.name: permissionId

204.description: Returned if the request is successful.

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.

404.description:
Returned if:

 *  the filter is not found.
 *  the user does not own the filter.
